title: Provisions the City's own bargaining summaries call outdated
question: When agreements were renewed, which provisions did the Department of Human Resources describe as outdated or obsolete and remove?
finding: 21 passages in 104 distinct bargaining summaries use "outdated" or "obsolete"; 13 concern pay or premiums (for example a physicians' premium built into steps 11-20, police retention and POST certificate language). Most are clean-up of language already superseded.
how: Every bargaining summary attached to an agreement file, read once (duplicates removed), searched for the two words; quotes are the words around each match.
limits: A summary is the Department of Human Resources' description of the change, not the agreement text; "outdated" often means language that no longer had effect. Summaries exist mainly from 2019 on.
